Package org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.pages

Class RowDetails

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.pages.RowDetails
public final class RowDetails extends Object
The expandable row details of the console tables, shared by the page builders (which only need the declaration) and the resources that serve them (which pass a real lookup).

A bean-backed detail lists its fields explicitly, so the resource that serves it never depends on having been attached to a table. Each field list equals the columns of the table it opens from, hidden ones included.

Example:

// A page builder attaches the declaration; the resource serves it with a store lookup. TableSpec.create("orders").detail(RowDetails.order());
